- Crazy_Top reference (Corn_Disease_33): near-identical bushy proliferation of multiple leaf-like structures at the top, chaotic and dense
- Crazy_Top reference (Corn_Disease_72): narrow strap-like leaves proliferating in a bushy cluster - same pattern
- Head_Smut: dark spore masses - doesn't match green leafy proliferation
- All leaf-spot/rust/blight classes: show lesion patterns on leaves, not whole-plant structural deformity

The visual match to Crazy_Top is unambiguous.
